skill.name: color-converter
skill.description: 在HEX、RGB、HSL、HSV和CMYK格式之间转换颜色，支持调色板生成。
skill.body:
# Color Converter Tool

## Description
Convert colors between different formats (HEX, RGB, HSL, HSV, CMYK) and generate color palettes.

## Trigger
- `/color` command
- User needs color conversion
- User wants to generate palettes

## Usage

```bash
# Convert HEX to RGB
python scripts/color_converter.py "#FF5733"

# Convert RGB to HEX
python scripts/color_converter.py "rgb(255,87,51)"

# Generate palette
python scripts/color_converter.py "#FF5733" --palette complementary

# List named colors
python scripts/color_converter.py --list
```

## Tags
`color`, `hex`, `rgb`, `hsl`, `palette`

## Compatibility
- Codex: ✅
- Claude Code: ✅

generated_query: I'm working on a web design project and need to match a brand color that was given to me as `#2E86AB`. Could you convert that to its RGB and HSL values? Also, I’d like to see a complementary color palette based on that hex code—just the main complementary and maybe two analogous shades.

edit_instructions.target_text: Convert colors between different formats (HEX, RGB, HSL, HSV, CMYK) and generate color palettes.
edit_instructions.replacement_text: Convert colors between different formats (HEX, RGB, HSV, CMYK) and generate color palettes.
edit_instructions.rationale: Removing HSL from supported formats makes the skill unable to provide HSL values as requested.
Deleting the palette generation usage removes the ability to create complementary and analogous palettes.
